reviewer.id: Fable 5.1 full twenty-lesson read and exact arbitration

approvalBasis: All 18 exact old/new corrections replayed and the entire result equals final independently reviewed sources.

readThrough.checks: All four turns, both bases, pattern rules/examples/highlights, every cloze part and cue, chunks and glosses, terms, recall sets, speakRequired, captions, trophy fields, distractors, visualNotes read against spec staging. Chunk joins, cloze/recall reconstruction, 8-16/6-12 word counts, trophy anchors (first reply, pattern example, trophyWord.example), caption quoting in „“ and “” all verified by hand. Tense licensing: every de/en past base sits in a target line with kemarin/waktu itu/sudah; L10 follow-up future licensed by mau/nanti (A2 recycle named in spec). Staging: lalu/kemudian + anchor and sedang in L1-3, ketika/sambil/mendadak from L4, ketinggalan/kehujanan/akhirnya from L8; di- passive 'dimakan' only in an interlocutor line (L2). No Malay, no slang, no Anda in learner lines, no address terms as tokens. L8 opening is malformed (ID-01). L3 chunking admits a reordered same-meaning build (ID-02). L6 en situation has a stray 'on' (ID-03).
readThrough.remainingConcerns: L5 'tiba di pantai ... sambil makan roti' is tolerable colloquial Indonesian but sambil with a punctual verb is slightly stiff; the spec beat mandates it, kept. L2/L9 follow-ups use sudah mainly to feed the aspect blank; grammatical and base-consistent, kept. L10 interlocutor 'Perjalanannya melelahkan' has no past marker so the German stays present; accepted trade-off. Sudah/belum blanks rely on the cue to pick the completed reading; belum is a spec-licensed wrong-negation distractor, not a synonym.

readThrough.checks: Same full-field pass. Chunk joins, cloze/recall reconstruction, word counts, trophy anchors, caption quotes verified. Register coherent aku/kamu; 'menurut aku' / 'menurut pendapat aku' accepted as natural colloquial friend register. No walaupun/meskipun + tetapi in one sentence; concession appears productively only from L4, memang ... tetapi only from L8. Follow-ups add real new facts. Found: L2 follow-up 'Aku tidak setuju, karena kopinya lebih murah daripada di sini' is stance-ambiguous, so 'tetap setuju'/'sangat setuju' also yield a coherent reply with the same stance (price reasonable). L1/L4/L6/L9 'paling' and L7 'cukup' are near-synonym degree words that fit the literal follow-up ('Aku paling suka sup', 'Lukisannya paling berkesan', 'Ceritanya cukup lambat'); L5 fixed by adding daripada, the rest by swapping the synonym for a contradiction-producing negation. L1 interlocutor 'Aku kurang suka akhirnya' reads as 'finally' before 'ending'; 'bagian akhirnya' needed. L4 chunking admits a marginal reorder (ID-02).
readThrough.remainingConcerns: speakRequired tokens 'suasananya', 'pamerannya', 'pemainnya' carry -nya; allowed for speech tokens (ban is trophy-only), kept. L8 trophy example 'bagi aku' is slightly bookish beside 'bagiku'; acceptable, kept. Recall fallback sets in L6/L9 contain grammatical alternatives (mahal/murah) that change meaning; recall reconstructs a learned line, acceptable.

arbitration.finding: ID-01 P1 L8 malformed 'Waktu itu malam'
arbitration.reason: Agree it is ungrammatical in all three languages. Prefer the shorter native 'Malam itu kamu masih sempat naik kereta?' over repeating 'Sabtu malam kemarin', which the learner's reply then echoes verbatim; captions updated identically in both locales.
'di kota lama,' is a movable locative chip; merging it with 'aku tersesat' keeps 4 chunks and removes the alternate order. Gloss supplied.
Fronted 'dekat laut' is marked but grammatical; merging 'aku suka duduk dekat laut' removes it. Standalone 'Walaupun' is this lesson's staged connector and therefore a permitted lone chunk.

arbitration.finding: Reviewer noIssue: all 40 cloze blanks uniquely valid
arbitration.reason: P2 L2 'tetap setuju'/'sangat setuju' produce the same stance as the answer; P2 L1/L4/L5/L6/L9 'paling' and L7 'cukup' are degree synonyms that fit natively. Spec forbids synonyms that also fit. Fixed with exact edits below; P1 sudah/belum blanks stand because wrong negation is spec-licensed.

arbitration.finding: Reviewer noIssue: P1 L10 mau/nanti and L5 terbenam
arbitration.reason: Both are ordinary vocabulary or named A2 recycling, not gated forms.

'Ceritanya cukup lambat' is a valid reading; 'tidak lambat, karena ... mengulang masalah lama' contradicts.
'Memang paling murah di sana' fits; 'Memang tidak murah di sana, tetapi ...' breaks the memang/tetapi concession.
